meal_plan.title: Dinner at Alex's
meal_plan.note: Bring dessert and a bottle of something.

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
recipes.description: Charred, yogurt-marinated chicken in a creamy tomato sauce. Serve with basmati rice and warm naan.

steps.name: Marinate the chicken
steps.text:
In a large bowl, combine the following, then add the chicken and turn to coat:

- 1 cup plain yogurt
- 2 tbsp lemon juice
- 1 tbsp grated ginger & 4 minced garlic cloves
- 2 tsp garam masala (see below)

Cover and marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
steps.html:
In a large bowl, combine the following, then add the chicken and turn to coat:

  • 1 cup plain yogurt
  • 2 tbsp lemon juice
  • 1 tbsp grated ginger & 4 minced garlic cloves
  • 2 tsp garam masala (see below)

Cover and marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 8 hours in the fridge.

steps.name: Grill the chicken
steps.text:
Preheat the oven to 450°F (230°C) and line a baking sheet. Thread the chicken onto skewers and roast for 12-15 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges.

Keep the juices from the pan for the sauce.
steps.html:
Preheat the oven to 450°F (230°C) and line a baking sheet. Thread the chicken onto skewers and roast for 12-15 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges.

Keep the juices from the pan for the sauce.

steps.name: Start the sauce
steps.text: Melt the butter in a large, deep pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes, until soft and golden. Stir in the tomato paste, salt and the remaining ginger and cook until the paste darkens.

steps.name: Simmer
steps.text: Add the crushed tomatoes, then simmer for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and the oil separates.

steps.name: Finish with cream
steps.text: Stir in the cream and the roasted chicken with any juices. Heat gently for 2 minutes without boiling. Taste and adjust the salt.

steps.name: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Combine with the water and a pinch of salt, bring to a boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes. Rest, covered, for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

steps.name: Serve
steps.text: Scatter with cilantro and serve with the rice and warm naan.

recipes.name: No-Knead Crusty Bread
recipes.description: A bakery-style loaf with almost no work. The dough does its thing overnight.

steps.name: Mix the dough
steps.text: Whisk the flour, salt and yeast in a large bowl. Add the water and stir until no dry flour remains. The dough will be wet and shaggy. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap.

steps.name: First rise
steps.text: Let the dough rest at room temperature for 12-18 hours, until the surface is dotted with bubbles and it has more than doubled.

steps.name: Shape
steps.text: Turn the dough out onto a floured surface, fold it over itself a few times and shape it into a ball. Set it on parchment paper, cover loosely and rest for 30 minutes while the oven heats.

steps.name: Heat the pot
steps.text: Place a Dutch oven with its lid in the oven and preheat to 450°F (230°C).

steps.name: Bake covered
steps.text: Carefully lower the dough, on its parchment, into the hot pot. Cover and bake.

steps.name: Bake uncovered
steps.text: Remove the lid and bake for another 12-15 minutes, until the crust is deep golden brown.

steps.name: Cool
steps.text: Cool on a wire rack for at least 1 hour before slicing. The crust crackles as it cools.

recipes.name: Greek Salad with Feta & Olives
recipes.description: Crunchy vegetables, salty feta and a sharp oregano dressing. No cooking.

steps.name: Chop the vegetables
steps.text: Cut the tomatoes into wedges. Slice the cucumber and the bell pepper, and slice the red onion thinly.

steps.name: Dress
steps.text: Whisk the olive oil, vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper in a large bowl. Add the vegetables and the olives and toss gently.

steps.name: Top and serve
steps.text: Lay the feta on top in one slab, drizzle with a little more olive oil and sprinkle with oregano.

recipes.name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
recipes.description: Ten minutes, one pan.

steps.name: Sear the shrimp
steps.text: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and pepper. Sear in a hot skillet with the oil, 2 minutes per side, until pink.

steps.name: Add the garlic butter
steps.text: Lower the heat. Add the butter, garlic and lemon juice and spoon over the shrimp for 1 minute. Finish with parsley.

recipes.name: Spaghetti alla Carbonara (the real Roman way, no cream, no peas, no garlic)
recipes.description: Guanciale, egg yolks, pecorino and plenty of black pepper. Nothing else.

steps.name: Render the guanciale
steps.text: Cut the guanciale into small strips and cook it slowly in a cold, dry pan until the fat renders and the edges crisp, about 8 minutes.

steps.name: Make the egg mix
steps.text: Whisk the egg yolks with the pecorino and a generous amount of black pepper.

steps.name: Toss
steps.text: Boil the spaghetti in well-salted water until al dente. Move it to the pan with a splash of pasta water, take it off the heat, add the egg mix and toss quickly until creamy.

recipes.name: Classic Margherita Pizza
recipes.description: Thin crust, san marzano tomatoes, fresh mozzarella and basil.

steps.name: Make the dough
steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, salt and water and knead for 8 minutes. Cover and let rise for 1 hour, until doubled.

steps.name: Top
steps.text: Stretch the dough, spread with crushed tomatoes and scatter torn mozzarella.

steps.name: Bake
steps.text: Bake on the hottest setting for 8-10 minutes. Finish with fresh basil and olive oil.

recipes.name: Beef Chili con Carne
recipes.description: Smoky, slow-cooked and better the next day.

steps.name: Brown the beef
steps.text: Brown the beef in a large pot, breaking it up, then add the onion and cook until soft.

steps.name: Simmer
steps.text: Add the spices, tomatoes and beans. Simmer gently for 90 minutes, stirring now and then.

recipes.name: Pad Thai with Tofu
recipes.description: Sweet, sour and salty rice noodles with crispy tofu.

steps.name: Prep
steps.text: Soak the noodles in warm water for 20 minutes. Mix the tamarind, fish sauce and sugar into a sauce.

steps.name: Fry the tofu
steps.text: Fry the cubed tofu in a hot wok until golden on all sides. Set aside.

steps.name: Stir-fry
steps.text: Stir-fry the noodles with the sauce, bean sprouts and tofu for 3 minutes. Serve with peanuts and lime.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
recipes.description: Eggs poached in spiced tomato and pepper sauce.

steps.name: Cook the sauce
steps.text: Soften the onion and pepper in olive oil, add the garlic and spices, then the tomatoes. Simmer for 10 minutes.

steps.name: Add the eggs
steps.text: Make wells in the sauce and crack in the eggs. Cover and cook until the whites are set.

recipes.name: French Onion Soup
recipes.description: Deeply caramelised onions under a lid of toasted bread and melted Gruyère.

steps.name: Caramelise the onions
steps.text: Cook the sliced onions in butter over medium-low heat for 45 minutes, stirring often, until deep brown.

steps.name: Add the stock
steps.text: Deglaze with wine, add the stock and thyme and simmer for 20 minutes.

steps.name: Broil
steps.text: Ladle into bowls, top with bread and cheese and broil until bubbling.

recipes.name: Crème Brûlée
recipes.description: A silky vanilla custard under a thin sheet of burnt sugar.

steps.name: Make the custard
steps.text: Warm the cream with the vanilla. Whisk the yolks with the sugar, then slowly whisk in the warm cream.

steps.name: Bake in a water bath
steps.text: Pour into ramekins and bake in a water bath at 325°F (160°C) for 40 minutes, until just set with a slight wobble.

steps.name: Chill and torch
steps.text: Chill for at least 4 hours. Sprinkle with sugar and caramelise with a torch just before serving.

recipes.name: Pão de Queijo
recipes.description: Chewy Brazilian cheese puffs made with tapioca flour.

steps.name: Make the batter
steps.text: Heat the milk, oil and salt until just boiling. Pour over the tapioca flour and stir. Beat in the eggs and cheese.

steps.name: Bake
steps.text: Roll into balls and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 20-25 minutes, until puffed and pale golden.

recipes.name: Jägerschnitzel with Mushroom Gravy
recipes.description: Crisp breaded pork cutlets under a creamy mushroom sauce.

steps.name: Bread the cutlets
steps.text: Pound the pork thin, season, and coat in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.

steps.name: Fry
steps.text: Fry in hot oil for 3-4 minutes per side until golden. Keep warm.

steps.name: Gravy
steps.text: In the same pan cook the mushrooms and onion, add the stock and cream and reduce until it coats a spoon.

recipes.name: Köttbullar with Lingonberry Sauce
recipes.description: Swedish meatballs with cream gravy.

steps.name: Mix and roll
steps.text: Soak the breadcrumbs in milk, mix with the meat, onion, allspice and salt, and roll into small balls.

steps.name: Brown
steps.text: Brown the meatballs in butter in batches, about 6 minutes each.

steps.name: Gravy
steps.text: Whisk flour into the pan, add stock and cream, simmer until thick. Serve with lingonberry jam.

recipes.name: Vegetable Stir-Fry with Ginger and Garlic
recipes.description: Whatever vegetables you have, cooked fast and hot.

steps.name: Prep
steps.text: Slice all vegetables to the same thickness. Mix the soy sauce, ginger and garlic.

steps.name: Stir-fry
steps.text: Stir-fry the hard vegetables for 3 minutes, add the soft ones and the sauce and cook for 2 minutes more.

recipes.name: Banana Bread
recipes.description: Moist, extra banana-y, with a crunchy top.

steps.name: Mix
steps.text: Mash the bananas, stir in the melted butter, sugar, egg and vanilla, then fold in the flour, baking soda and salt.

steps.name: Bake
steps.text: Pour into a greased loaf pan and bake at 350°F (175°C) for 55-60 minutes. A skewer should come out clean.

recipes.name: Grandma's Famous Sunday Morning Blueberry Buttermilk Pancakes with Maple Butter
recipes.description: Fluffy, tangy and loaded with blueberries.

steps.name: Make the batter
steps.text: Whisk the dry ingredients. Mix the buttermilk, egg and melted butter, then stir into the dry mix until just combined. Let it rest for 5 minutes.

steps.name: Cook
steps.text: Cook ladlefuls on a buttered griddle until bubbles form, flip and cook until golden. Serve with maple butter.

recipes.name: Lemon Garlic Roast Chicken
recipes.description: A whole chicken with crisp skin and a pan sauce.

steps.name: Prepare
steps.text: Pat the chicken dry. Rub with butter, salt, pepper and minced garlic. Stuff the cavity with lemon halves.

steps.name: Roast
steps.text: Roast at 425°F (220°C) for 70-80 minutes, until the juices run clear. Rest for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Mushroom Risotto
recipes.description: Creamy arborio rice with mixed mushrooms and parmesan.

steps.name: Cook the mushrooms
steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in butter, season and set aside.

steps.name: Cook the rice
steps.text: Toast the rice with the shallot, add wine, then add hot stock a ladleful at a time for about 20 minutes, stirring.

steps.name: Finish
steps.text: Stir in the mushrooms, butter and parmesan. Rest for 2 minutes.

recipes.name: Fish Tacos with Lime Crema
recipes.description: Crispy fish, crunchy slaw, cool lime crema.

steps.name: Cook the fish
steps.text: Season the fish with cumin and chili and pan-fry for 3 minutes per side.

steps.name: Make the crema
steps.text: Stir the sour cream with lime juice and zest, and a pinch of salt.

steps.name: Assemble
steps.text: Warm the tortillas, then fill with fish, slaw and crema.

recipes.name: Garam Masala Blend
recipes.description: Warm, sweet spice blend for curries.

steps.name: Toast the whole spices
steps.text: Toast the cumin, coriander, cardamom, cloves and cinnamon in a dry pan over medium heat until fragrant, about 2 minutes.

steps.name: Grind
steps.text: Cool the spices, then grind to a fine powder. Store in a jar.

recipes.name: Slow-Roasted Pork Shoulder with Apple Cider Glaze and Crispy Crackling
recipes.description: Eight hours in a low oven, then a blast of heat for the crackling.

steps.name: Season
steps.text: Score the skin, rub the shoulder with salt, fennel seeds and pepper, and set it on a bed of sliced apples and onions.

steps.name: Slow roast
steps.text: Roast at 275°F (135°C) for 7-8 hours, brushing with the cider glaze every hour.

steps.name: Crackling
steps.text: Raise the oven to 475°F (245°C) and roast for 20 minutes, until the skin blisters and crackles. Rest for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: Crisp edges, chewy middles.

steps.name: Cream and mix
steps.text: Beat the butter and sugars until fluffy. Beat in the eggs and vanilla, then fold in the flour, baking soda, salt and chocolate.

steps.name: Bake
steps.text: Scoop onto trays and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 9-11 minutes, until the edges are golden.

recipes.name: Caesar Salad
recipes.description: Crunchy romaine, garlicky croutons, a punchy dressing.

steps.name: Dressing
steps.text: Mash the anchovies and garlic, whisk in the mustard, lemon juice, parmesan and olive oil.

steps.name: Toss
steps.text: Toss the romaine and croutons with the dressing and shave parmesan over the top.

recipes.name: Tomato Basil Soup
recipes.description: Roasted tomatoes blended with basil and a little cream.

steps.name: Soften
steps.text: Soften the onion and garlic in olive oil for 5 minutes.

steps.name: Simmer and blend
steps.text: Add the tomatoes and stock, simmer for 15 minutes, add basil and blend until smooth.

recipes.name: Vegan Black Bean Burgers
recipes.description: Smoky patties that hold together.

steps.name: Mash
steps.text: Mash the beans roughly, mix with the oats, spices and sauteed onion, and shape into patties.

steps.name: Cook
steps.text: Pan-fry for 5 minutes per side until crisp.

recipes.name: Thai Green Curry
recipes.description: Fragrant, creamy and fast.

steps.name: Fry the paste
steps.text: Fry the green curry paste in a little coconut cream for 2 minutes.

steps.name: Simmer
steps.text: Add the chicken, coconut milk, vegetables and fish sauce. Simmer for 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Apple Crumble
recipes.description: Spiced apples under a buttery oat topping.

steps.name: Prepare the apples
steps.text: Toss the sliced apples with sugar, cinnamon and lemon juice in a baking dish.

steps.name: Crumble and bake
steps.text: Rub the butter into the flour, oats and sugar, scatter over the apples and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 40-45 minutes.

recipes.name: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
recipes.description: Breakfast in ten minutes.

steps.name: Poach
steps.text: Slip the egg into barely simmering water with a splash of vinegar and poach for 3 minutes.

steps.name: Assemble
steps.text: Mash the avocado with lemon and salt, spread on toast, and top with the egg.

recipes.name: Overnight Oats
recipes.description: Prepare it tonight, eat it tomorrow.

steps.name: Mix
steps.text: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds and a little honey in a jar.

steps.name: Chill
steps.text: Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours. Top with fruit before eating.
